task: predict public-bike rentals per active hour from weather and calendar features

source_holdout.fit_source: Capital Bikeshare, Washington DC, UCI dataset 275
source_holdout.confirmation_source: Seoul Bike Sharing System, UCI dataset 560
source_holdout.independent_source_rule: all learned generator state is fit only on Capital Bikeshare; Seoul labels are not passed to generator fit or source transforms

entity_and_time_policy.entity: service date; all hourly rows for one date stay in one partition
entity_and_time_policy.capital_bikeshare: retain 2011 only; first 75 percent of ordered service dates fit, final 25 percent select
entity_and_time_policy.seoul: sort all service dates; first 50 percent fit, next 20 percent select, final 30 percent test
entity_and_time_policy.fit_transforms: fit only on the source fit rows; do not tune on selection or confirmation rows

target.estimand: observed aggregate rentals in the held-out source's active operating hours

selection.candidate: No model selection; fixed DOPE, Gaussian copula, and compressed-row controls are run under both byte caps and both sample sizes.

primary_loss: mean squared error in bikes-squared per hour
driver_diagnostic: single-feature permutation-loss increase and Ridge coefficient sign on the same held-out Seoul rows; report TDL reducer state and keep interaction unavailable
exposure_disclosure: The public sources were previously used in an unqualified DOPE-only observational run. This comparator extension is exploratory and is not confirmatory or an untouched-data result.

gaussian_copula.sampler: Gaussian rank transform, fitted correlation, inverse empirical marginal quantiles

compressed_row_subsample.sampler: seeded fit-row subsample sampled with replacement
